# ferentin_data_protection_profile (Data Source)

Look up one built-in data-protection profile by name (e.g. `US_PII`). Referencing `.name` gives plan-time validation that the profile exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Singular — look one profile up by name (plan-time validation that it exists).
data "ferentin_data_protection_profile" "us_pii" {
  name = "US_PII"
}

# Reference it from a policy instead of hardcoding the string.
resource "ferentin_data_protection_policy" "example" {
  name             = "pii-only"
  enabled_profiles = [data.ferentin_data_protection_profile.us_pii.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name, e.g. `US_PII`.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `category` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `detectors` (List of String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `region` (String)
